items.question: I photocopied the travel reimbursement forms.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“I photocopied the travel reimbursement forms.”，自然应答是“Thanks for doing that.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：B（Thanks for doing that.）。
items.evidence: 参考原文第 1 段：I photocopied the travel reimbursement forms.
